headline: Xen Orchestra flaws exploited; York University breach exposes 19 years of data; OpenSSH SSHole due 11-12, Barracuda ESG due 11-13

bullets.text: New: critical Xen Orchestra flaws are being exploited in attacks (SecurityWeek; 3 outlets now covering it). The brief gives no CVEs or fixed releases yet.

New: Canada's York University says a breach exposed 19 years of student health and financial data. Earlier today Credit Mutuel Arkea reported €100m missing after a cyberattack; Wyndham, Fullerton Health and hundreds of Dutch sports clubs also reported breaches.

Qlik Sense servers are being hit with reverse shells while attackers stage ActiveMQ and Veeam exploits (The Hacker News). AntiFox AI agents are used in AWS credential-theft attacks. Git fixed six flaws, including code execution during recursive clones.
Due tomorrow, 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited to breach Linux systems, 3 outlets), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218.

Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 (auth bypass) and CVE-2026-111560 (OS command injection) are exploited (4 outlets); KEV due 11-13, as is Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 and Openwave Webtop CVE-2026-111793 are due 11-24.

Still active: N-able released hotfixes for the published N-central zero-days (4 outlets); Vanderbilt on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets); Maersk probing data theft; Poland's ePUAP shut down. The week ran 1.15x the 90-day average.

actions: Inventory Xen Orchestra instances, keep their web interfaces off the internet, and apply vendor fixes as soon as they are available.
Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (due 11-13) and hunt for compromise; patch Citrix and Ivanti Connect Secure.
Check internet-facing Qlik Sense servers for reverse shells, patch ActiveMQ and Veeam hosts, and update Git on developer machines and CI runners.
N-central customers: apply the hotfixes. Patch Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave Webtop, Outlook (CVE-2026-124194) and Chrome before 11-24.
Review AWS access keys and CloudTrail for unusual use, and rotate any credentials that may be exposed.
